'''Yinta Lake''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vulta]]. It began as a small, unnamed [[Winter/Legends|winter]] retreat for the planet's wealthy arms manufacturers, who built extensive mansions along the banks of [[Lake Yinta]], Vulta's largest [[Water/Legends|freshwater]] lake. After the construction of a [[Yinta Lake spaceport|spaceport]], the town, then known as '''Yinta''' began to attract individuals of middle and lower classes. As the town grew into the city of Yinta Lake, the wealthy left the metropolis and the area fell into poverty. [[Zeerid Korr]] and his daughter, [[Arra Yooms]] grew up in Yinta Lake.
